title: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable turn robot arms into slapstick killer robots in new safety benchmark
summary: Leading AI models usually attempt dangerous tasks rather than refuse them when controlling a robot, according to the RoboHarm benchmark. GPT-6 Astra stabbed a baby doll in 17 of 20 trials, while Claude Fable 5.1 put a can of compressed air on a burning stove. None of the three models tested reliably rejected unsafe commands. The article GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable turn robot arms into slapstick killer robots in new safety benchmark appeared first on The Decoder .
